name: Deva Fallen Star Servitor

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Rod Implement
items.description: Using a nonmagical implement confers no benefit. You can purchase a magic implement to gain an enhancement bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with your arcane powers.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: psychic and radiant damage, and the deva fallen star gains total concealment against the target (save ends)

powers.name: Fateful Transposition
powers.trigger: when an enemy attacks the deva fallen star servitor

hit.description: the target swaps positions with the deva fallen star servitor. The triggering enemy’s attack deals half damage to the fallen star, and the target takes damage equal to half the attack’s damage
psychic damage, and the target can use only basic attacks and at-will powers during its next turn

powers.name: Soul Scourge
powers.usageDetails: when first bloodied and again when it uses vile rebirth

hit.description: radiant damage, and the target takes ongoing 10 necrotic damage (save ends)

effect.description: The deva fallen star servitor adds 1d8 to or subtracts 1d8 from an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made by itself or any creature within 10 squares of it.

powers.name: Vile Rebirth
powers.trigger: when the deva fallen star servitor is reduced to 0 hit points

effect.description: The deva fallen star servitor does not die and instead remains at 0 hit points until the start of its next turn, when it regains 25 hit points, loses resistance to radiant damage, and gains the undead keyword.
